services.name: Tour Options and Guides
services.desc: Miami sightseeing by water isn't just another way to explore the city-it's the perspective that helps you understand why Miami was built around Biscayne Bay. While most visitors experience Miami from busy streets, sidewalks, and beaches, the city's skyline, islands, waterfront neighborhoods, marinas, and famous landmarks were all designed to be admired from the water. It's a completely different experience. At Miami Celebrity Boat Tours, we've watched thousands of visitors board expecting to see celebrity homes, only to leave talking about the incredible skyline, hidden islands, PortMiami, massive cruise ships, local wildlife, and the beauty of Biscayne Bay itself. It's the moment people

services.name: 🌃 Night
services.desc: So you have witness the best sightseeing Cruise in Miami during the day. Now is time to enjoy the best 90 minute sightseeing Cruise at night from Bayside Marketplace. Come and join us today, and explore Miami Star Island under the Moon and Stars. This Miami Night cruise is especial en many ways, you get to enjoy the beauty of Biscayne Bay, Miami Skyline, Miami Beach, South Beach, the Venetian Islands, Hibiscus Island, Palm Island, the beautiful Port of Miami at Night. blurb: A Miami Celebrity Boat Tour is a 90-minute guided cruise in Miami departing from Bayside, operating all year round. Experience 360-degree panoramic views of Miami’s top landmarks, including Star Island, Fisher Island, Venetian Islands, Port of Miami, Miami Beach, South Beach, Virginia Key, Brickell Key, the entrance to the Miami River, and the historic Flagler Monument.
